evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Jevic: 'this should take about ten minutes so we can provide you an accurate estimate, you can depend on, sounds good.' — Time-boxed and promise of dependable quote present, but rushed past Joe's confirmation ('Okay') without a real wait for affirmation before diving into agenda.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Jevic: 'What are your biggest concerns for this upcoming move?' — Asked early, before logistics probing started. Joe responds: 'Just getting it done in time, I suppose. And making sure nothing gets damaged.'
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Jevic acknowledges 'efficiency and we got you covered on that for sure' but immediately pivots to 'let me just go ahead and confirm the details' with no follow-up dig into either concern raised.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Jevic covers: property type (two bedroom apartment), floor/stories (third floor, elevator access), walking distances (100 ft ground level, ~150 ft top), additional rooms (none), special considerations (bed, couch, TV, dresser, nightstands, desks, chairs, bookcase, TV stand, exercise bike), additional stops (two-story house destination). Comprehensive coverage.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Jevic: 'a typical two bedroom apartment usually takes three and a half to five and a half hours... in your case... I would estimate the move to be between six and a half to seven and a half hours... it's safe to budget around $1,375 to $1,575' — Range given with personalization (third floor, long walk, 30-min drive, alerts noted).
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Jevic: '$200 per hour per two movers... $75 trip fee... no hidden fees... no credit card fees, no deposit, no upfront payment... two and a half hour minimum... time is prorated in fifteen minute increments.' Full fee transparency and commitment framing present.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Jevic: 'do you have questions or clarifications about the, you know, the, about the pricing and the estimate, and how it works?' — Asked, but Joe immediately responds with past-move comparison (not a silence). Jevic does not ask 'Does that feel fair?' at all.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Jevic: 'if we can make it in the time window that we arrange we immediately start discounting money of your final bill' — Discount-on-late framing fully delivered.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Jevic: 'no worries damage coverage... we provide up to $2,000 per move to repair, replace or reimburse for accidental damage.' — Amount and coverage stated, but missing explicit no-deductible/no-fine-print framing.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Jevic: 'So would you like our help with your upcoming move on October 24th Saturday?' — Asked plainly. Joe: 'Could you kind of send me this quote just in an email and, and I can think about it.' Rep then agrees to email: 'I'll go ahead and send you an email... if you're ready to proceed then you know, just go ahead and give us a call to, to, to save a spot for you.' — Built-in out provided ('just go ahead and give us a call' is softer than booking confirmation; email pathway offered instead of securing commitment).

top_strength: Jevic gathered comprehensive logistics details (all seven items: property type, floor, rooms, walking distances, additional rooms, special items, destination details) and provided a fully anchored, personalized estimate with transparent fee structure.
coaching_note: Stop after raising concerns: ask 'tell me more about that' for each concern Joe mentioned (getting it done in time, nothing gets damaged) before moving on — you acknowledged them but never dug in, and you never reflected back what you heard to confirm you understood.
